text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! What do you mean 'To Be Continued'!?
They haven't even caught the culprit yet!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, talking about what's next is already—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait... It's already midnight?
...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I should really stop after just one more episode.
Just one more...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, "To be continued next time"!?
No way! Uggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be, I'm watching this to the very end!!
You'd better catch the culprit next time, got it!?
—A few days later, I heard a rumor that King Halo had stayed up all night watching dramas until morning...
